name: MERGE2-writ-renown-to-no-track
old: db.prepare(`UPDATE renown_tracks SET xp = MIN(?7, xp + (SELECT renown FROM writs WHERE id = ?5 AND n = ?6)), updated_at = ?3
new: db.prepare(`UPDATE renown_tracks SET xp = MIN(?7, xp + 0 * (SELECT renown FROM writs WHERE id = ?5 AND n = ?6)), updated_at = ?3
note: A writ past the first adds nothing: the account's track the first one made is never grown.

name: MERGE2-writ-renown-full-rate
old: export const writRenown = (tier, units) => renownRate((25 * tier * units) / 10);
new: export const writRenown = (tier, units) => (25 * tier * units) / 10;
note: The writ's Renown at the full rate - RENOWN-ACCOUNT's three quarters not taken.

name: MERGE2-writ-renown-first-track-never-made
old:
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM renown_tracks WHERE player = ?1 AND char_id = ?2)
        AND ${renownHeldSql('?1')} < ?8`)
note: An account with no Renown yet gets none from its first writ.

name: MERGE2-qae-online-no-own-time
